units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 4:9">B. Kam. IV, 9</cite> <he>חֲ׳ נזק</he> half the damage.

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 4:5">Gitt. IV, 5</cite> <he>מי שחֶצְיוֹ עבד וכ׳</he> he who is half a slave and half a freedman (having been emancipated by one of the partners); a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>חֲצָיִים</he>, <he>חֲצָיִין</he>, <he>חֲצָאִים</he>, <he>חֲצָאִין</he>. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. X, Par. 9 <he>לא יביאנה ח׳</he> he must not offer it in parts.

<cite ref="Nedarim 83a:3">Ned. 83ᵃ</cite> <he>אין נזירות לח׳</he> there is no nazaritism by halves, i.e. one cannot vow to be a nazarite by partial abstinence; <he>ואין קרבן לח׳</he> nor is there a sacrifice for partial nazaritism.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 1:6:2">Y. Hor. I, 46ᵇ</cite> top <he>אין הפסח לה׳</he> the Passover offering does not take place in divisions (of clean and unclean parties).
<cite ref="Keritot 5a:66">Kerith. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>מפטם לח׳</he> taking only a part of each ingredient; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:5:5">Y. Yoma IV, 41ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>פיטמה ח׳</he>; a. fr.
